talents.name: Spear of Favonius — Broken Oath
talents.desc:
**Normal Attack**
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

**Charged Attack**
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a forward thrust.

**Plunging Attack**
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

talents.name: Unforeseen Strike
talents.desc:
As he searches for weaknesses, Lohen switches to **Masterstroke** mode. While in this state:
· Lohen can actively accumulate **Joy**, using it to unleash the special Elemental Skill **Etched Into Bone and Soul**.
· Nearby party members can accumulate **Will to Win** for Lohen, increasing the DMG dealt by **Etched Into Bone and Soul**.
Lohen can unleash **Etched Into Bone and Soul** up to 3 times while in **Masterstroke** mode, after which, he will no longer be able to accumulate **Joy**.

**"Chivalry? Hah, what better way to bait the trap? When an enemy dreams of an honorable victory, they inevitably fail to suspect the 'pleasant surprise' that awaits them."**
[Details title="Masterstroke"]Lohen switches to this mode after he unleashes the Elemental Skill **Unforeseen Strike**. Masterstroke mode has the following characteristics:
· DMG dealt by Lohen's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted to **Cryo DMG** that cannot be overridden by other infusions.
· When Lohen hits an opponent with a Normal Attack or Charged Attack, he accumulates **Joy** that can be used to unleash the special Elemental Skill **Etched Into Bone and Soul**. Lohen can unleash **Etched Into Bone and Soul** up to 3 times while in **Masterstroke** mode, after which, he will no longer be able to accumulate **Joy**.
· When nearby party members deal DMG, they also accumulate **Will to Win** for Lohen that can be used to increase the DMG dealt by **Etched Into Bone and Soul**.
· Masterstroke mode ends when Lohen leaves the field. When Masterstroke mode ends, **Joy** and **Will to Win** will be reset to zero.[/Details]
[Details title="Joy"]When Lohen hits opponents with a Normal Attack or Charged Attack while in Masterstroke mode, he will accumulate 17 **Joy**. Up to 100 Joy may be accumulated at any one time.
**Joy** can be accumulated once every 0.1s. Once **Joy** reaches its max limit, Lohen's Elemental Skill **Unforeseen Strike** will be replaced with the special Elemental Skill **Etched Into Bone and Soul**.[/Details]
[Details title="Etched Into Bone and Soul"]A special Elemental Skill that Lohen can use after his **Joy** reaches the max limit.
After hitting an opponent, consumes all **Joy** and **Will to Win** to deal **Cryo DMG**. This DMG increases based on the amount of **Will to Win** consumed.[/Details]
[Details title="Will to Win"]A special resource accumulated when other nearby party members deal DMG while Lohen is in Masterstroke mode. Up to 100 Will to Win may be accumulated at any one time.
While Masterstroke mode is active, when other nearby party members deal DMG, if that DMG is not less than 1000% of Lohen's Base ATK, he accumulates 20 **Will to Win**. Otherwise, he accumulates 1 **Will to Win**.
Each character can accumulate **Will to Win** for Lohen once every 0.1s.[/Details]
